facts.business: RTCL Limited is an Indian listed company holding its 32nd Annual General Meeting for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion on three matters: (1) Non-current investments in equity shares recognized at cost (Rs.1201.80 Lakhs) instead of fair value per Ind AS 109, impact not quantifiable; (2) Debtors of Rs.38.54 lakhs due over six months with no provision; (3) Ongoing litigation with M/s Superior Fabrics Private Limited involving Rs.450 lakhs (Rs.345.20 lakhs inventory + Rs.105 lakhs advances) with no provision. Emphasis of matter on unconfirmed balances of debtors, creditors, advances & loans; inventory valuation reliance on management; and inability to comment on physical verification of Property, Plant & Equipment.

key_risks: Non-compliance with Ind AS 109 for investment valuation
Unprovided doubtful debtors of Rs.38.54 lakhs
Litigation exposure of Rs.450 lakhs with M/s Superior Fabrics Private Limited
Unconfirmed balances of debtors, creditors, advances and loans
Reliance on management for inventory valuation without independent verification
No physical verification report for Property, Plant & Equipment
